title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom — Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
titleEn: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom — Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
description: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom — Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is the dedicated Switch 2 version of Nintendo's acclaimed open-air sequel. It preserves the giant three-layer world, Ultrahand building, Fuse customization, and the broad freedom of exploration, while positioning the software as an upgraded edition for Nintendo Switch 2 hardware. It stands alongside an official upgrade path and the original Nintendo Switch release.

gameplayPillars.title: Dedicated Switch 2 edition profile
gameplayPillars.description: The game is represented as a native Nintendo Switch 2 software entry rather than only the original release.

gameplayPillars.title: All invention systems preserved
gameplayPillars.description: Ultrahand, Fuse, Ascend, and Recall remain the core systems that define the sequel's creativity.

gameplayPillars.title: Enhanced presentation expectations
gameplayPillars.description: The Switch 2 Edition is positioned as the improved way to play the game on newer Nintendo hardware.

gameplayPillars.title: Large-scale exploration structure
gameplayPillars.description: Surface Hyrule, sky islands, and the Depths still combine into one of Nintendo's richest exploration spaces.

gameplayPillars.title: Store-friendly clean edition split
gameplayPillars.description: Keeping the Switch 2 Edition separate from the original release improves platform clarity inside the storefront.

worldSummary: This edition preserves the full scale of Tears of the Kingdom while representing it cleanly as a Switch 2 product with its own performance and product-identity profile.

storyChapters.title: Investigate the disaster beneath Hyrule
storyChapters.body: The journey begins with a mysterious upheaval that reshapes the kingdom and separates Link from Zelda.

storyChapters.title: Use new powers to survive and create
storyChapters.body: Each of Link's major new abilities changes how traversal, combat, and puzzles work across the entire map.

storyChapters.title: Help the regions of Hyrule
storyChapters.body: Regional stories and temples reintroduce a stronger arc structure while keeping broad freedom intact.

storyChapters.title: Uncover the sky and the Depths
storyChapters.body: The adventure grows richer by stacking new areas above and below the original world.

storyChapters.title: Reach the climactic finale
storyChapters.body: The late game brings story revelations, harder encounters, and one of the series' more ambitious endings.

features: One of Nintendo's highest-rated open-world adventures
Huge three-layer world full of secrets and puzzles
Clean split from the original release for import accuracy

faq.q: Is this the same as the original Switch release?
faq.a: No. This file is specifically for the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Tears of the Kingdom.

faq.q: Does the Switch 2 Edition have separate pricing in the store?
faq.a: Yes. This extraction keeps it as a separate product with its own pricing and platform identity.

faq.q: Is there DLC for Tears of the Kingdom?
faq.a: No official standalone DLC has been announced, so only the base game variants are included here.

faq.q: What is the main reason to keep this as a separate import entry?
faq.a: The dedicated platform identity prevents confusion between the original Switch release, the upgrade pack, and the enhanced Switch 2 Edition.

faq.q: Does it still include the same story and world?
faq.a: Yes. The core adventure content remains the same major sequel to Breath of the Wild.

verdictPros: Massive world and creativity systems remain exceptional
Clearer than mixing the edition into the original listing
Still among Nintendo's best modern adventures
verdictCons: Core content is familiar if you finished the original release
